title: एकत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Somadatta, grieving for his son Bhurishravas, fights Satyaki in fury and is struck down. Ashvatthaman and Ghatotkacha fight, the demon's arrows hitting Ashvatthaman in the chest, and the gods watch the night battle.
summary.kn: ಮಗ ಭೂರಿಶ್ರವನ ಶೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೋಮದತ್ತ ಕೋಪದಿಂದ ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿಯೊಡನೆ ಹೋರಾಡಿ ಬೀಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಾಮ-ಘಟೋತ್ಕಚರು ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಘಟೋತ್ಕಚನ ಬಾಣಗಳು ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಾಮನ ಎದೆಗೆ ತಾಗುತ್ತವೆ; ದೇವತೆಗಳು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಯುದ್ಧ ನೋಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: पुत्र भूरिश्रवा के शोक में सोमदत्त क्रोध से सात्यकि से लड़ता है और मारा जाता है। अश्वत्थामा और घटोत्कच लड़ते हैं, राक्षस के बाण अश्वत्थामा की छाती में लगते हैं, और देवता रात्रियुद्ध देखते हैं।
summary.te: కొడుకు భూరిశ్రవుని శోకంతో సోమదత్తుడు కోపంగా సాత్యకితో పోరాడి పడిపోతాడు. అశ్వత్థామ, ఘటోత్కచుడు పోరాడతారు; ఘటోత్కచుని బాణాలు అశ్వత్థామ ఛాతీకి తగులుతాయి; దేవతలు రాత్రియుద్ధాన్ని చూస్తారు.
summary.ta: மகன் பூரிசிரவஸின் துயரால் சோமதத்தன் சினத்துடன் சாத்யகியுடன் போரிட்டு வீழ்கிறான். அஸ்வத்தாமனும் கடோத்கசனும் போரிட, அரக்கனின் அம்புகள் அஸ்வத்தாமனின் மார்பில் தைக்கின்றன; தேவர்கள் இரவுப்போரைப் பார்க்கின்றனர்.
summary.ml: പുത്രന്റെ മരണത്തിൽ ദുഃഖിതനായ സോമദത്തൻ കോപത്തോടെ സാത്യകിയോട് പൊരുതി വീഴുന്നു. അശ്വത്ഥാമാവും ഘടോൽക്കചനും ഏറ്റുമുട്ടുന്നു; രാക്ഷസന്റെ അമ്പുകൾ അശ്വത്ഥാമാവിന്റെ മാറിൽ പതിക്കുന്നു; രാത്രിയിലെ യുദ്ധം ദേവന്മാർ കാണുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.131; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
प्रायोपविष्टे तु हते पुत्रे सात्यकिना ततः ।
सोमदत्तो भृशं क्रुद्धः सात्यकिं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: When his son, who was fasting unto death, had been killed by Satyaki, Somadatta, greatly enraged, spoke to Satyaki.

verses.text:
क्षत्रधर्मः पुरा दृष्टो यस्तु देवैर्महात्मभिः ।
तं त्वं सात्वत संत्यज्य दस्युधर्मे कथं रतः ॥

meaning.en: "Satvata, you have abandoned the warrior's duty which the great-souled gods saw of old, so how are you devoted to a bandit's way?

verses.text:
पराङ्मुखाय दीनाय न्यस्तशस्त्राय याचते ।
क्षत्रधर्मरतः प्राज्ञः कथं नु प्रहरेद्रणे ॥

meaning.en: How could a wise man devoted to the warrior's duty strike in battle a man who is turned away, wretched, weaponless and begging?

verses.text:
द्वावेव किल वृष्णीनां तत्र ख्यातौ महारथौ ।
प्रद्युम्नश्च महाबाहुस्त्वं चैव युधि सात्वत ॥

meaning.en: Among the Vrishnis only two were famous there as great chariot-fighters: mighty-armed Pradyumna and you, Satvata, in battle.

verses.text:
कथं प्रायोपविष्टाय पार्थेन छिन्नबाहवे ।
नृशंसं पतनीयं च तादृशं कृतवानसि ॥

meaning.en: How did you do such a cruel and degrading thing to one who sat fasting, his arm cut off by Partha?

verses.text:
शपे सात्वत पुत्राभ्यामिष्टेन सुकृतेन च ।
अनतीतामिमां रात्रिं यदि त्वां वीरमानिनम् ॥

meaning.en: I swear, Satvata, by my two sons and by my sacrifices and good deeds: if this night does not pass,

verses.text:
अरक्ष्यमाणं पार्थेन जिष्णुना ससुतानुजम् ।
न हन्यां निरये घोरे पतेयं वृष्णिपांसन ॥

meaning.en: and I do not kill you, you who think yourself a hero, unprotected by Partha Jishnu, with your son and younger brother, then may I fall into dreadful hell, disgrace of the Vrishnis."

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा सुसंक्रुद्धः सोमदत्तो महाबलः ।
दध्मौ शङ्खं च तारेण सिंहनादं ननाद च ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, mighty Somadatta, in great anger, blew his conch loudly and roared a lion's roar.

verses.text:
ततः कमलपत्राक्षः सिंहदंष्ट्रो महाबलः ।
सात्वतो भृशसंक्रुद्धः सोमदत्तमथाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Then the lotus-eyed, lion-toothed, mighty Satvata, greatly enraged, answered Somadatta.

verses.text:
हतो भूरिश्रवा वीरस्तव पुत्रो महारथः ।
शलश्चैव तथा राजन्भ्रातृव्यसनकर्शितः ॥

meaning.en: "Your son, the hero and great chariot-fighter Bhurishravas, is dead, and so is Shala, king, worn by grief for his brother.

verses.text:
त्वां चाप्यद्य वधिष्यामि सपुत्रपशुबान्धवम् ।
तिष्ठेदानीं रणे यत्तः कौरवोऽसि विशेषतः ॥

meaning.en: Today I shall kill you too, with your sons, cattle and kin. Stand now and fight, being on guard, for you are a Kaurava above all.

verses.text:
यस्मिन्दानं दमः शौचमहिंसा ह्रीर्धृतिः क्षमा ।
अनपायीनि सर्वाणि नित्यं राज्ञि युधिष्ठिरे ॥

meaning.en: In King Yudhishthira, who has the mridanga on his banner, giving, self-control, purity, harmlessness, modesty, steadiness and forbearance all dwell, never leaving him.

verses.text:
मृदङ्गकेतोस्तस्य त्वं तेजसा निहतः पुरा ।
सकर्णसौबलः संख्ये विनाशं समुपेष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: You were long ago struck down by his radiance, and you will meet your ruin in battle with Karna and Shakuni's son.

verses.text:
शपेऽहं कृष्णचरणैरिष्टापूर्तेन चैव ह ।
यदि त्वां ससुतं पापं न हन्यां युधि रोषितः ।
अपयास्यसि चेत्त्यक्त्वा ततो मुक्तो भविष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: I swear by Krishna's feet and by my sacrifices and good works: if I do not kill you, sinner, with your son in battle when I am angry, I shall be free only if you flee and give up the fight."

verses.text:
एवमाभाष्य चान्योन्यं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनौ ।
प्रवृत्तौ शरसंपातं कर्तुं पुरुषसत्तमौ ॥

meaning.en: So taunting each other, their eyes red with rage, those two best of men began to shower arrows.

verses.text:
ततो गजसहस्रेण रथानामयुतेन च ।
दुर्योधनः सोमदत्तं परिवार्य व्यवस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Then Duryodhana stood surrounding Somadatta with a thousand elephants and ten thousand chariots.

verses.text:
शकुनिश्च सुसंक्रुद्धः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः ।
पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृतो भ्रातृभिश्चेन्द्रविक्रमैः ।
स्यालस्तव महाबाहुर्वज्रसंहननो युवा ॥

meaning.en: And Shakuni too, enraged, best of all who bear weapons, surrounded by his sons and grandsons and brothers of Indra-like valor, your strong-armed brother-in-law, young and with a body hard as a thunderbolt,

verses.text:
साग्रं शतसहस्रं तु हयानां तस्य धीमतः ।
सोमदत्तं महेष्वासं समन्तात्पर्यरक्षत ॥

meaning.en: and more than a hundred thousand horses of that wise man protected the great bowman Somadatta on every side.

verses.text:
रक्ष्यमाणश्च बलिभिश्छादयामास सात्यकिम् ।
तं छाद्यमानं विशिखैर्दृष्ट्वा संनतपर्वभिः ।
धृष्टद्युम्नोऽभ्ययात्क्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य महतीं चमूम् ॥

meaning.en: Protected by the strong, he covered Satyaki. Seeing him covered with straight-jointed arrows, Dhrishtadyumna, angry, rushed in with a great force.

verses.text:
चण्डवाताभिसृष्टानामुदधीनामिव स्वनः ।
आसीद्राजन्बलौघानामन्योन्यमभिनिघ्नताम् ॥

meaning.en: The sound of the armies, as they struck one another, O king, was like the sound of oceans lashed by a fierce wind.

verses.text:
विव्याध सोमदत्तस्तु सात्वतं नवभिः शरैः ।
सात्यकिर्दशभिश्चैनमवधीत्कुरुपुंगवम् ॥

meaning.en: Somadatta pierced the Satvata with nine arrows, and Satyaki with ten struck that bull of the Kurus.

verses.text:
सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता समरे दृढधन्वना ।
रथोपस्थं समासाद्य मुमोह गतचेतनः ॥

meaning.en: Deeply pierced in the battle by the strong, firm bowman, he reached the seat of his chariot and fainted, unconscious.

verses.text:
तं विमूढं समालक्ष्य सारथिस्त्वरयान्वितः ।
अपोवाह रणाद्वीरं सोमदत्तं महारथम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him stunned, his charioteer hurriedly carried the great chariot-fighter, the hero Somadatta, away from the battle.

verses.text:
तं विसंज्ञं समालोक्य युयुधानशरार्दितम् ।
द्रौणिरभ्यद्रवत्क्रुद्धः सात्वतं रणमूर्धनि ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him unconscious and wounded by Yuyudhana's arrows, Drona's son angrily rushed at the Satvata at the head of the battle.

verses.text:
तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य शैनेयस्य रथं प्रति ।
भैमसेनिः सुसंक्रुद्धः प्रत्यमित्रमवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him attack toward Shaineya's chariot, Bhimasena's son, greatly enraged, checked that enemy.

verses.text:
कार्ष्णायसमयं घोरमृक्षचर्मावृतं महत् ।
युक्तं गजनिभैर्वाहैर्न हयैर्नापि वा गजैः ॥

meaning.en: He mounted a vast chariot made of black iron, covered with bear skin, fearsome and large, drawn by animals like elephants, neither horses nor elephants,

verses.text:
विक्षिप्तमष्टचक्रेण विवृताक्षेण कूजता ।
ध्वजेनोच्छ्रिततुण्डेन गृध्रराजेन राजता ॥

meaning.en: rattling with eight wheels, with open hubs, bearing a banner with a high-beaked king of vultures shining on it,

verses.text:
लोहितार्द्रपताकं तमन्त्रमालाविभूषितम् ।
अष्टचक्रसमायुक्तमास्थाय विपुलं रथम् ॥

meaning.en: its banner wet with blood and adorned with garlands of entrails, joined with eight wheels,

verses.text:
शूलमुद्गरधारिण्या शैलपादपहस्तया ।
रक्षसां घोररूपाणामक्षौहिण्या समावृतः ॥

meaning.en: and surrounded by an akshauhini of fierce-looking rakshasas armed with spears and maces, holding rocks and trees in their hands.

verses.text:
तमुद्यतमहाचापं निशाम्य व्यथिता नृपाः ।
युगान्तकालसमये दण्डहस्तमिवान्तकम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him with his great bow raised, like Death with a rod in his hand at the end of the age, the kings were shaken.

verses.text:
भयार्दिता प्रचुक्षोभ पुत्रस्य तव वाहिनी ।
वायुना क्षोभितावर्ता गङ्गेवोर्ध्वतरङ्गिणी ॥

meaning.en: Your son's army, tormented by fear, heaved like the Ganga with waves raised high, its whirlpools stirred by wind.

verses.text:
घटोत्कचप्रयुक्तेन सिंहनादेन भीषिताः ।
प्रसुस्रुवुर्गजा मूत्रं विव्यथुश्च नरा भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Frightened by the lion's roar sent out by Ghatotkacha, elephants let fall their urine and men suffered greatly.

verses.text:
ततोऽश्मवृष्टिरत्यर्थमासीत्तत्र समन्ततः ।
संध्याकालाधिकबलैः प्रमुक्ता राक्षसैः क्षितौ ॥

meaning.en: Then a great rain of stones fell everywhere, hurled to the ground by rakshasas, whose strength was greatest at twilight.

verses.text:
आयसानि च चक्राणि भुशुण्ड्यः प्रासतोमराः ।
पतन्त्यविरलाः शूलाः शतघ्न्यः पट्टिशास्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Iron discs, bhushundis, lances, spears, spikes, shataghnis and pattishas fell in dense streams.

verses.text:
तदुग्रमतिरौद्रं च दृष्ट्वा युद्धं नराधिपाः ।
तनयास्तव कर्णश्च व्यथिताः प्राद्रवन्दिशः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that fierce and very terrible fight, the kings, your sons and Karna were distressed and fled in all directions.

verses.text:
तत्रैकोऽस्त्रबलश्लाघी द्रौणिर्मानी न विव्यथे ।
व्यधमच्च शरैर्मायां घटोत्कचविनिर्मिताम् ॥

meaning.en: There Drona's son alone, proud of the power of his weapons and not shaken, destroyed with arrows the illusion made by Ghatotkacha.

verses.text:
निहतायां तु मायायाममर्षी स घटोत्कचः ।
विससर्ज शरान्घोरांस्तेऽश्वत्थामानमाविशन् ॥

meaning.en: When his illusion was destroyed, Ghatotkacha, resentful, loosed fierce arrows, which entered Ashvatthama,

verses.text:
भुजगा इव वेगेन वल्मीकं क्रोधमूर्छिताः ।
ते शरा रुधिराभ्यक्ता भित्त्वा शारद्वतीसुतम् ।
विविशुर्धरणीं शीघ्रा रुक्मपुङ्खाः शिलाशिताः ॥

meaning.en: like snakes, in anger and fury, into an anthill. Smeared with blood, they pierced the son of Sharadvat's daughter and quickly entered the ground, gold-feathered and whetted on stone.

verses.text:
अश्वत्थामा तु संक्रुद्धो लघुहस्तः प्रतापवान् ।
घटोत्कचमभिक्रुद्धं बिभेद दशभिः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Ashvatthama, angry, quick-handed and mighty, pierced the enraged Ghatotkacha with ten arrows.

verses.text:
घटोत्कचोऽतिविद्धस्तु द्रोणपुत्रेण मर्मसु ।
चक्रं शतसहस्रारमगृह्णाद्व्यथितो भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Deeply wounded in his vitals by Drona's son, Ghatotkacha, in great pain, took up a disc of a hundred thousand spokes.

verses.text:
क्षुरान्तं बालसूर्याभं मणिवज्रविभूषितम् ।
अश्वत्थाम्नस्तु चिक्षेप भैमसेनिर्जिघांसया ॥

meaning.en: Edged like a razor, bright as the young sun, adorned with jewels and diamonds, Bhima's son hurled it at Ashvatthama, wishing to kill him.

verses.text:
वेगेन महता गच्छद्विक्षिप्तं द्रौणिना शरैः ।
अभाग्यस्येव संकल्पस्तन्मोघं न्यपतद्भुवि ॥

meaning.en: Rushing with great speed, it was knocked aside by Drona's arrows and fell to the ground in vain, like the plan of an unlucky man.

verses.text:
घटोत्कचस्ततस्तूर्णं दृष्ट्वा चक्रं निपातितम् ।
द्रौणिं प्राच्छादयद्बाणैः स्वर्भानुरिव भास्करम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the disc fallen, Ghatotkacha quickly covered Drona's son with arrows, as Svarbhanu covers the sun.

verses.text:
घटोत्कचसुतः श्रीमान्भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमः ।
रुरोध द्रौणिमायान्तं प्रभञ्जनमिवाद्रिराट् ॥

meaning.en: Ghatotkacha's glorious son, like a heap of crushed collyrium, stopped Drona's son as he came, as a king of mountains stops the wind.

verses.text:
पौत्रेण भीमसेनस्य शरैः सोऽञ्जनपर्वणा ।
बभौ मेघेन धाराभिर्गिरिर्मेरुरिवार्दितः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by the arrows of Bhimasena's grandson Anjanaparvan, Ashvatthama looked like Mount Meru beaten by streams from a cloud.

verses.text:
अश्वत्थामा त्वसंभ्रान्तो रुद्रोपेन्द्रेन्द्रविक्रमः ।
ध्वजमेकेन बाणेन चिच्छेदाञ्जनपर्वणः ॥

meaning.en: But unshaken Ashvatthama, with the valor of Rudra, Upendra and Indra, cut Anjanaparvan's banner with one arrow,

verses.text:
द्वाभ्यां तु रथयन्तारं त्रिभिश्चास्य त्रिवेणुकम् ।
धनुरेकेन चिच्छेद चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान् ॥

meaning.en: his charioteer with two, his triple pole with three, his bow with one, and his four horses with four.

verses.text:
विरथस्योद्यतं हस्ताद्धेमबिन्दुभिराचितम् ।
विशिखेन सुतीक्ष्णेन खड्गमस्य द्विधाकरोत् ॥

meaning.en: When the chariotless one raised a sword studded with gold dots, Ashvatthama split it in two with a very sharp arrow.

verses.text:
गदा हेमाङ्गदा राजंस्तूर्णं हैडिम्बसूनुना ।
भ्राम्योत्क्षिप्ता शरैः सापि द्रौणिनाभ्याहतापतत् ॥

meaning.en: The mace with golden armlets, quickly whirled and hurled by Hidimba's grandson, was struck down by Drona's son with arrows and fell.

verses.text:
ततोऽन्तरिक्षमुत्पत्य कालमेघ इवोन्नदन् ।
ववर्षाञ्जनपर्वा स द्रुमवर्षं नभस्तलात् ॥

meaning.en: Then, leaping into the sky and roaring like a dark cloud, Anjanaparvan rained down a shower of trees from the heavens.

verses.text:
ततो मायाधरं द्रौणिर्घटोत्कचसुतं दिवि ।
मार्गणैरभिविव्याध घनं सूर्य इवांशुभिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona's son pierced the illusion-wielding son of Ghatotkacha in the sky with arrows, as the sun pierces a cloud with rays.

verses.text:
सोऽवतीर्य पुनस्तस्थौ रथे हेमपरिष्कृते ।
महीधर इवात्युच्चः श्रीमानञ्जनपर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: He came down and stood again on a gold-adorned chariot, glorious Anjanaparvan, tall as a mountain.

verses.text:
तमयस्मयवर्माणं द्रौणिर्भीमात्मजात्मजम् ।
जघानाञ्जनपर्वाणं महेश्वर इवान्धकम् ॥

meaning.en: Drona's son killed the iron-armored Anjanaparvan, Bhima's grandson, as Maheshvara killed Andhaka.

verses.text:
अथ दृष्ट्वा हतं पुत्रमश्वत्थाम्ना महाबलम् ।
द्रौणेः सकाशमभ्येत्य रोषात्प्रचलिताङ्गदः ॥

meaning.en: Then, seeing his mighty son killed by Ashvatthama, Ghatotkacha, his armlets shaking with rage, came up to Drona's son.

verses.text:
प्राह वाक्यमसंभ्रान्तो वीरं शारद्वतीसुतम् ।
दहन्तं पाण्डवानीकं वनमग्निमिवोद्धतम् ॥

meaning.en: He spoke without fear to the hero son of Sharadvat's daughter, who was burning the Pandava army like a blazing fire a forest.

verses.text:
तिष्ठ तिष्ठ न मे जीवन्द्रोणपुत्र गमिष्यसि ।
त्वामद्य निहनिष्यामि क्रौञ्चमग्निसुतो यथा ॥

meaning.en: "Stand, stand, son of Drona! You will not go alive. Today I shall kill you as Skanda, fire's son, killed Krauncha."

verses.text: अश्वत्थामोवाच

meaning.en: Ashvatthama said:

verses.text:
गच्छ वत्स सहान्यैस्त्वं युध्यस्वामरविक्रम ।
न हि पुत्रेण हैडिम्बे पिता न्याय्यं प्रबाधितुम् ॥

meaning.en: "Go, child, and fight with others, you of divine valor. It is not right for a father to be harmed by a son, son of Hidimba.

verses.text:
कामं खलु न मे रोषो हैडिम्बे विद्यते त्वयि ।
किं तु रोषान्वितो जन्तुर्हन्यादात्मानमप्युत ॥

meaning.en: I truly feel no anger toward you, Hidimba's son; but a creature filled with anger may even kill himself."

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
श्रुत्वैतत्क्रोधताम्राक्षः पुत्रशोकसमन्वितः ।
अश्वत्थामानमायस्तो भैमसेनिरभाषत ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this, his eyes red with fury and filled with grief for his son, Bhima's son spoke to Ashvatthama, gathering himself.

verses.text:
किमहं कातरो द्रौणे पृथग्जन इवाहवे ।
भीमात्खल्वहमुत्पन्नः कुरूणां विपुले कुले ॥

meaning.en: "Am I a coward, son of Drona, like any common man in battle? I was born of Bhima in the great Kuru family.

verses.text:
पाण्डवानामहं पुत्रः समरेष्वनिवर्तिनाम् ।
रक्षसामधिराजोऽहं दशग्रीवसमो बले ॥

meaning.en: I am the son of the Pandavas, who never turn back in battles. I am lord of the rakshasas, equal to Dashagriva in strength.

verses.text:
तिष्ठ तिष्ठ न मे जीवन्द्रोणपुत्र गमिष्यसि ।
युद्धश्रद्धामहं तेऽद्य विनेष्यामि रणाजिरे ॥

meaning.en: Stand, stand, son of Drona, you will not go alive. Today in this field I shall cure you of your zeal for battle."

verses.text:
इत्युक्त्वा रोषताम्राक्षो राक्षसः सुमहाबलः ।
द्रौणिमभ्यद्रवत्क्रुद्धो गजेन्द्रमिव केसरी ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, the mighty rakshasa, his eyes red with rage, rushed angrily at Drona's son like a lion at an elephant-king.

verses.text:
रथाक्षमात्रैरिषुभिरभ्यवर्षद्घटोत्कचः ।
रथिनामृषभं द्रौणिं धाराभिरिव तोयदः ॥

meaning.en: Ghatotkacha rained arrows the size of chariot-axles on Drona's son, bull among chariot-fighters, as a cloud rains in streams.

verses.text:
शरवृष्टिं शरैर्द्रौणिरप्राप्तां तां व्यशातयत् ।
ततोऽन्तरिक्षे बाणानां संग्रामोऽन्य इवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Drona's son shattered that shower of arrows with his own before it reached him, and then a different battle of arrows took place in the sky.

verses.text:
अथास्त्रसंघर्षकृतैर्विस्फुलिङ्गैः समाबभौ ।
विभावरीमुखे व्योम खद्योतैरिव चित्रितम् ॥

meaning.en: By the sparks made from the clash of weapons, the sky at night's beginning shone as if painted with fireflies.

verses.text:
निशाम्य निहतां मायां द्रौणिना रणमानिना ।
घटोत्कचस्ततो मायां ससर्जान्तर्हितः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing his illusion destroyed by Drona's son, proud of his fighting, Ghatotkacha, hidden, again made an illusion.

verses.text:
सोऽभवद्गिरिरत्युच्चः शिखरैस्तरुसंकटैः ।
शूलप्रासासिमुसलजलप्रस्रवणो महान् ॥

meaning.en: He became a very high mountain with peaks thick with trees, with spears, lances, swords and clubs flowing as its streams.

verses.text:
तमञ्जनचयप्रख्यं द्रौणिर्दृष्ट्वा महीधरम् ।
प्रपतद्भिश्च बहुभिः शस्त्रसंघैर्न चुक्षुभे ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that mountain, like a heap of collyrium, with many hosts of weapons falling, Drona's son was not shaken.

verses.text:
ततः स्मयन्निव द्रौणिर्वज्रमस्त्रमुदीरयत् ।
स तेनास्त्रेण शैलेन्द्रः क्षिप्तः क्षिप्रमनश्यत ॥

meaning.en: Then, as if smiling, Drona's son brought forth the thunderbolt weapon, and by that weapon the king of mountains was struck and quickly vanished.

verses.text:
ततः स तोयदो भूत्वा नीलः सेन्द्रायुधो दिवि ।
अश्मवृष्टिभिरत्युग्रो द्रौणिमाच्छादयद्रणे ॥

meaning.en: Then he became a dark cloud in the sky with Indra's bow, and covered Drona's son in the battle with terrible showers of stones.

verses.text:
अथ संधाय वायव्यमस्त्रमस्त्रविदां वरः ।
व्यधमद्द्रोणतनयो नीलमेघं समुत्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the best of those who know weapons fitted the wind weapon and Drona's son scattered the dark cloud that had risen.

verses.text:
स मार्गणगणैर्द्रौणिर्दिशः प्रच्छाद्य सर्वतः ।
शतं रथसहस्राणां जघान द्विपदां वरः ॥

meaning.en: Covering all directions on every side with showers of arrows, Drona's son, best of men, killed a hundred thousand chariots.

verses.text:
स दृष्ट्वा पुनरायान्तं रथेनायतकार्मुकम् ।
घटोत्कचमसंभ्रान्तं राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतम् ॥

meaning.en: He saw Ghatotkacha, calm and surrounded by many rakshasas, coming again in a chariot with a long bow,

verses.text:
सिंहशार्दूलसदृशैर्मत्तद्विरदविक्रमैः ।
गजस्थैश्च रथस्थैश्च वाजिपृष्ठगतैरपि ॥

meaning.en: with rakshasas like lions and tigers, with the prowess of rutting elephants, riding elephants, chariots and horses,

verses.text:
विवृतास्यशिरोग्रीवैर्हैडिम्बानुचरैः सह ।
पौलस्त्यैर्यातुधानैश्च तामसैश्चोग्रविक्रमैः ॥

meaning.en: with open mouths, heads and necks, followers of Hidimba's son, descendants of Pulastya, yatudhanas and night-prowlers of fierce valor,

verses.text:
नानाशस्त्रधरैर्वीरैर्नानाकवचभूषणैः ।
महाबलैर्भीमरवैः संरम्भोद्वृत्तलोचनैः ॥

meaning.en: heroes holding many weapons, wearing many armors and ornaments, mighty and of dreadful cries, their eyes rolling with excitement.

verses.text:
उपस्थितैस्ततो युद्धे राक्षसैर्युद्धदुर्मदैः ।
विषण्णमभिसंप्रेक्ष्य पुत्रं ते द्रौणिरब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing those rakshasas, wild for battle, stand ready in the fight, and seeing your son dismayed, Drona's son said:

verses.text:
तिष्ठ दुर्योधनाद्य त्वं न कार्यः संभ्रमस्त्वया ।
सहैभिर्भ्रातृभिर्वीरैः पार्थिवैश्चेन्द्रविक्रमैः ॥

meaning.en: "Duryodhana, stand today, you must not be agitated, with these brothers and heroic kings of Indra-like valor.

verses.text:
निहनिष्याम्यमित्रांस्ते न तवास्ति पराजयः ।
सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि पर्याश्वासय वाहिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: I shall kill your enemies; you will not be defeated. I promise you truly; comfort your army."

verses.text: दुर्योधन उवाच

meaning.en: Duryodhana said:

verses.text:
न त्वेतदद्भुतं मन्ये यत्ते महदिदं मनः ।
अस्मासु च परा भक्तिस्तव गौतमिनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: "I do not find it wonderful that your mind is so great, and that your devotion to us is so high, son of Gautami's line."

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
अश्वत्थामानमुक्त्वैवं ततः सौबलमब्रवीत् ।
वृतः शतसहस्रेण रथानां रणशोभिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Having spoken so to Ashvatthama, he said to Subala's son, surrounded by a hundred thousand chariots splendid in war:

verses.text:
षष्ट्या गजसहस्रैश्च प्रयाहि त्वं धनंजयम् ।
कर्णश्च वृषसेनश्च कृपो नीलस्तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: "With sixty thousand elephants, go against Dhananjaya. Karna, Vrishasena, Kripa and Nila too,

verses.text:
उदीच्याः कृतवर्मा च पुरुमित्रः श्रुतार्पणः ।
दुःशासनो निकुम्भश्च कुण्डभेदी उरुक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: the northerners, Kritavarman, Purumitra, Shrutarpana, Duhshasana, Nikumbha, Kundabhedi, Urukrama,

verses.text:
पुरंजयो दृढरथः पताकी हेमपङ्कजः ।
शल्यारुणीन्द्रसेनाश्च संजयो विजयो जयः ॥

meaning.en: Puranjaya, Dridharatha, Patakin, Hemapankaja, Shalya, Aruni, Indrasena, Sanjaya, Vijaya, Jaya,

verses.text:
कमलाक्षः पुरुः क्राथी जयवर्मा सुदर्शनः ।
एते त्वामनुयास्यन्ति पत्तीनामयुतानि षट् ॥

meaning.en: Kamalaksha, Puru, Krathin, Jayavarman and Sudarshana: these will follow you, with six times ten thousand foot-soldiers.

verses.text:
जहि भीमं यमौ चोभौ धर्मराजं च मातुल ।
असुरानिव देवेन्द्रो जयाशा मे त्वयि स्थिता ॥

meaning.en: Kill Bhima, the two twins and the king of dharma, uncle, as Indra killed the asuras; my hope of victory rests on you.

verses.text:
दारितान्द्रौणिना बाणैर्भृशं विक्षतविग्रहान् ।
जहि मातुल कौन्तेयानसुरानिव पावकिः ॥

meaning.en: Those torn by Drona's son's arrows and badly wounded in body, kill them, uncle, the sons of Kunti, as Fire's son killed the asuras."

verses.text:
एवमुक्तो ययौ शीघ्रं पुत्रेण तव सौबलः ।
पिप्रीषुस्ते सुतान्राजन्दिधक्षुश्चैव पाण्डवान् ॥

meaning.en: Spoken to thus by your son, Subala's son went swiftly, wishing to please your sons and to burn the Pandavas.

verses.text:
अथ प्रववृते युद्धं द्रौणिराक्षसयोर्मृधे ।
विभावर्यां सुतुमुलं शक्रप्रह्रादयोरिव ॥

meaning.en: Then a tumultuous battle took place in the night between Drona's son and the rakshasa, like that of Indra and Prahlada.

verses.text:
ततो घटोत्कचो बाणैर्दशभिर्गौतमीसुतम् ।
जघानोरसि संक्रुद्धो विषाग्निप्रतिमैर्दृढैः ॥

meaning.en: Then enraged Ghatotkacha struck Gautami's son in the chest with ten strong arrows like poison and fire.

verses.text:
स तैरभ्याहतो गाढं शरैर्भीमसुतेरितैः ।
चचाल रथमध्यस्थो वातोद्धूत इव द्रुमः ॥

meaning.en: Struck hard by those arrows sent by Bhima's son, he swayed in the middle of his chariot like a tree shaken by wind.

verses.text:
भूयश्चाञ्जलिकेनास्य मार्गणेन महाप्रभम् ।
द्रौणिहस्तस्थितं चापं चिच्छेदाशु घटोत्कचः ॥

meaning.en: Again with an anjalika arrow Ghatotkacha quickly cut the shining bow in Drona's son's hand.

verses.text:
ततोऽन्यद्द्रौणिरादाय धनुर्भारसहं महत् ।
ववर्ष विशिखांस्तीक्ष्णान्वारिधारा इवाम्बुदः ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona's son took up another great bow able to bear the strain and rained sharp arrows like a cloud with streams of water.

verses.text:
ततः शारद्वतीपुत्रः प्रेषयामास भारत ।
सुवर्णपुङ्खाञ्शत्रुघ्नान्खचरान्खचरान्प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Then the son of Sharadvat's daughter, Bharata, sent gold-feathered, foe-slaying arrows at those sky-going rakshasas.

verses.text:
तद्बाणैरर्दितं यूथं रक्षसां पीनवक्षसाम् ।
सिंहैरिव बभौ मत्तं गजानामाकुलं कुलम् ॥

meaning.en: Tormented by his arrows, the herd of broad-chested rakshasas looked like a throng of elephants in rut troubled by lions.

verses.text:
विधम्य राक्षसान्बाणैः साश्वसूतरथान्विभुः ।
ददाह भगवान्वह्निर्भूतानीव युगक्षये ॥

meaning.en: Having shattered the rakshasas with arrows, with horses, charioteers and chariots, the mighty one burned them, as the blessed fire burns creatures at the end of an age.

verses.text:
स दग्ध्वाक्षौहिणीं बाणैर्नैरृतान्रुरुचे भृशम् ।
पुरेव त्रिपुरं दग्ध्वा दिवि देवो महेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: Having burned an akshauhini of night-walkers with arrows, he shone greatly, like the god Maheshvara in the sky after burning Tripura.

verses.text:
युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि दग्ध्वेव वसुरुल्बणः ।
रराज जयतां श्रेष्ठो द्रोणपुत्रस्तवाहितान् ॥

meaning.en: Like a fierce Vasu burning all creatures at the end of an age, the best of conquerors, Drona's son, shone, having burned your enemies.

verses.text:
तेषु राजसहस्रेषु पाण्डवेयेषु भारत ।
नैनं निरीक्षितुं कश्चिच्छक्नोति द्रौणिमाहवे ।
ऋते घटोत्कचाद्वीराद्राक्षसेन्द्रान्महाबलात् ॥

meaning.en: Among those thousands of kings of the Pandavas, Bharata, none but the hero Ghatotkacha, mighty lord of rakshasas, could look at Drona's son in the fight.

verses.text:
स पुनर्भरतश्रेष्ठ क्रोधाद्रक्तान्तलोचनः ।
तलं तलेन संहत्य संदश्य दशनच्छदम् ।
स्वसूतमब्रवीत्क्रुद्धो द्रोणपुत्राय मां वह ॥

meaning.en: Again, best of Bharatas, his eyes red-cornered with anger, he struck palm on palm and, biting his lip, said angrily to his charioteer: "Carry me to Drona's son."

verses.text:
स ययौ घोररूपेण तेन जैत्रपताकिना ।
द्वैरथं द्रोणपुत्रेण पुनरप्यरिसूदनः ॥

meaning.en: He went in that fearsome chariot with its banner of victory, and again, tormentor of foes, he fought Drona's son in single combat.

verses.text:
स चिक्षेप ततः क्रुद्धो द्रोणपुत्राय राक्षसः ।
अष्टचक्रां महारौद्रामशनीं रुद्रनिर्मिताम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the rakshasa in anger hurled at Drona's son a dreadful eight-wheeled thunderbolt made by Rudra.

verses.text:
तामवप्लुत्य जग्राह द्रौणिर्न्यस्य रथे धनुः ।
चिक्षेप चैनां तस्यैव स्यन्दनात्सोऽवपुप्लुवे ॥

meaning.en: Leaping up, Drona's son laid his bow in the chariot, caught it and hurled it back at him; the rakshasa leapt from his chariot.

verses.text:
साश्वसूतध्वजं वाहं भस्म कृत्वा महाप्रभा ।
विवेश वसुधां भित्त्वा साशनिर्भृशदारुणा ॥

meaning.en: The very bright and dreadful bolt reduced the chariot, horses, charioteer and banner to ashes, and split the earth and entered it.

verses.text:
द्रौणेस्तत्कर्म दृष्ट्वा तु सर्वभूतान्यपूजयन् ।
यदवप्लुत्य जग्राह घोरां शंकरनिर्मिताम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that deed of Drona's son, all beings honored him, because he leapt up and caught that fearful weapon made by Shankara.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नरथं गत्वा भैमसेनिस्ततो नृप ।
मुमोच निशितान्बाणान्पुनर्द्रौणेर्महोरसि ॥

meaning.en: Then, O king, Bhima's son went to Dhrishtadyumna's chariot and loosed sharp arrows again at Drona's son's broad chest.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नोऽप्यसंभ्रान्तो मुमोचाशीविषोपमान् ।
सुवर्णपुङ्खान्विशिखान्द्रोणपुत्रस्य वक्षसि ॥

meaning.en: Dhrishtadyumna too, unshaken, loosed gold-feathered arrows like venomous snakes into the chest of Drona's son.

verses.text:
ततो मुमोच नाराचान्द्रौणिस्ताभ्यां सहस्रशः ।
तावप्यग्निशिखाप्रख्यैर्जघ्नतुस्तस्य मार्गणान् ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona's son shot thousands of iron arrows at the two, and they, with arrows like tongues of fire, cut down his arrows.

verses.text:
अतितीव्रमभूद्युद्धं तयोः पुरुषसिंहयोः ।
योधानां प्रीतिजननं द्रौणेश्च भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: The battle between those two lions among men became very fierce, a joy to warriors, and to Drona's son, best of Bharatas.

verses.text:
ततो रथसहस्रेण द्विरदानां शतैस्त्रिभिः ।
षड्भिर्वाजिसहस्रैश्च भीमस्तं देशमाव्रजत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhima came to that place with a thousand chariots, three hundred elephants and six thousand horses.

verses.text:
ततो भीमात्मजं रक्षो धृष्टद्युम्नं च सानुगम् ।
अयोधयत धर्मात्मा द्रौणिरक्लिष्टकर्मकृत् ॥

meaning.en: Then the righteous Drona's son, of untroubled deeds, fought the rakshasa son of Bhima and Dhrishtadyumna with their followers.

verses.text:
तत्राद्भुततमं द्रौणिर्दर्शयामास विक्रमम् ।
अशक्यं कर्तुमन्येन सर्वभूतेषु भारत ॥

meaning.en: There Drona's son showed a most wondrous valor, impossible for any other among all creatures, Bharata.

verses.text:
निमेषान्तरमात्रेण साश्वसूतरथद्विपाम् ।
अक्षौहिणीं राक्षसानां शितैर्बाणैरशातयत् ॥

meaning.en: In the blink of an eye he destroyed with sharp arrows an akshauhini of rakshasas, with horses, charioteers, chariots and elephants.

verses.text:
मिषतो भीमसेनस्य हैडिम्बेः पार्षतस्य च ।
यमयोर्धर्मपुत्रस्य विजयस्याच्युतस्य च ॥

meaning.en: Before the eyes of Bhimasena, Hidimba's son, Prishata's son, the twins, the son of Dharma, Vijaya and Achyuta,

verses.text:
प्रगाढमञ्जोगतिभिर्नाराचैरभिताडिताः ।
निपेतुर्द्विरदा भूमौ द्विशृङ्गा इव पर्वताः ॥

meaning.en: elephants struck hard by straight-flying iron arrows fell to the ground like mountains with two peaks.

verses.text:
निकृत्तैर्हस्तिहस्तैश्च विचलद्भिरितस्ततः ।
रराज वसुधा कीर्णा विसर्पद्भिरिवोरगैः ॥

meaning.en: The ground, strewn with elephants' trunks cut off and writhing here and there, shone as though covered with creeping snakes.

verses.text:
क्षिप्तैः काञ्चनदण्डैश्च नृपच्छत्रैः क्षितिर्बभौ ।
द्यौरिवोदितचन्द्रार्का ग्रहाकीर्णा युगक्षये ॥

meaning.en: The earth, with royal parasols with golden staves thrown about, looked like the sky at the end of an age with sun and moon risen and strewn with planets.

verses.text:
प्रवृद्धध्वजमण्डूकां भेरीविस्तीर्णकच्छपाम् ।
छत्रहंसावलीजुष्टां फेनचामरमालिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: Drona's son made flow a river with banners for its frogs, drums for its broad tortoises, parasols and flocks of swans along its banks, foam for its whisks and garlands,

verses.text:
कङ्कगृध्रमहाग्राहां नैकायुधझषाकुलाम् ।
रथक्षिप्तमहावप्रां पताकारुचिरद्रुमाम् ॥

meaning.en: with kankas and vultures as its great crocodiles, many weapons as its fish, overturned chariots as its great banks, banners as its lovely trees,

verses.text:
शरमीनां महारौद्रां प्रासशक्त्युग्रडुण्डुभाम् ।
मज्जामांसमहापङ्कां कबन्धावर्जितोडुपाम् ॥

meaning.en: with arrows as its fish, very terrible, with spears and lances as its fierce water-snakes, thick mud of marrow and flesh, headless trunks as its upturned rafts,

verses.text:
केशशैवलकल्माषां भीरूणां कश्मलावहाम् ।
नागेन्द्रहययोधानां शरीरव्ययसंभवाम् ॥

meaning.en: turbid with hair as its weeds, bringing confusion to the timid, born from the ruin of the bodies of elephants, horses and warriors,

verses.text:
शोणितौघमहावेगां द्रौणिः प्रावर्तयन्नदीम् ।
योधार्तरवनिर्घोषां क्षतजोर्मिसमाकुलाम् ॥

meaning.en: swift with great floods of blood, resounding with the cries of fighting men and heaving with waves of blood, a great ocean flowing toward Yama's realm.

verses.text:
प्रायादतिमहाघोरं यमक्षयमहोदधिम् ।
निहत्य राक्षसान्बाणैर्द्रौणिर्हैडिम्बमार्दयत् ॥

meaning.en: Having killed the rakshasas with arrows, Drona's son oppressed Hidimba's son.

verses.text:
पुनरप्यतिसंक्रुद्धः सवृकोदरपार्षतान् ।
स नाराचगणैः पार्थान्द्रौणिर्विद्ध्वा महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Again, greatly angry, Drona's son, the strong one, pierced the sons of Pritha, with Vrikodara and Prishata's son, with masses of iron arrows,

verses.text:
जघान सुरथं नाम द्रुपदस्य सुतं विभुः ।
पुनः श्रुतंजयं नाम सुरथस्यानुजं रणे ॥

meaning.en: and killed Drupada's son named Suratha, and again Shrutanjaya, Suratha's younger brother, in battle.

verses.text:
बलानीकं जयानीकं जयाश्वं चाभिजघ्निवान् ।
श्रुताह्वयं च राजेन्द्र द्रौणिर्निन्ये यमक्षयम् ॥

meaning.en: He also struck down Balanika, Jayanika and Jayashva, and, O king, Drona's son sent Shrutahvaya to Yama's house.

verses.text:
त्रिभिश्चान्यैः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः सुपुङ्खै रुक्ममालिनम् ।
शत्रुंजयं च बलिनं शक्रलोकं निनाय ह ॥

meaning.en: With three other sharp, fine-feathered arrows he sent the strong Shatrunjaya, garlanded with gold, to Indra's world.

verses.text:
जघान स पृषध्रं च चन्द्रदेवं च मानिनम् ।
कुन्तिभोजसुतांश्चाजौ दशभिर्दश जघ्निवान् ॥

meaning.en: He killed Prishadhra and proud Chandradeva, and ten by ten he killed the sons of Kuntibhoja in the battle.

verses.text:
अश्वत्थामा सुसंक्रुद्धः संधायोग्रमजिह्मगम् ।
मुमोचाकर्णपूर्णेन धनुषा शरमुत्तमम् ।
यमदण्डोपमं घोरमुद्दिश्याशु घटोत्कचम् ॥

meaning.en: Ashvatthama, greatly enraged, fitted a fierce, straight arrow, and with his bow drawn to the ear loosed the best of arrows, dreadful as Yama's rod, quickly at Ghatotkacha.

verses.text:
स भित्त्वा हृदयं तस्य राक्षसस्य महाशरः ।
विवेश वसुधां शीघ्रं सपुङ्खः पृथिवीपते ॥

meaning.en: That great arrow pierced the rakshasa's heart and swiftly entered the earth with its feathers, O lord of the earth.

verses.text:
तं हतं पतितं ज्ञात्वा धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः ।
द्रौणेः सकाशाद्राजेन्द्र अपनिन्ये रथान्तरम् ॥

meaning.en: Knowing him fallen and struck down, the great chariot-fighter Dhrishtadyumna carried Drona's son's opponent away to another chariot.

verses.text:
तथा पराङ्मुखरथं सैन्यं यौधिष्ठिरं नृप ।
पराजित्य रणे वीरो द्रोणपुत्रो ननाद ह ।
पूजितः सर्वभूतैश्च तव पुत्रैश्च भारत ॥

meaning.en: Thus, having defeated Yudhishthira's army with its chariots turned away, O king, the hero, Drona's son, roared, honored by all beings and by your sons, Bharata.

verses.text:
अथ शरशतभिन्नकृत्तदेहै-
र्हतपतितैः क्षणदाचरैः समन्तात् ।
निधनमुपगतैर्मही कृताभू-
द्गिरिशिखरैरिव दुर्गमातिरौद्रा ॥

meaning.en: The earth, with night-walkers cut and broken by hundreds of arrows, fallen dead and lying in all directions, was made like a dreadful mountain with peaks.

verses.text:
तं सिद्धगन्धर्वपिशाचसंघा
नागाः सुपर्णाः पितरो वयांसि ।
रक्षोगणा भूतगणाश्च द्रौणि-
मपूजयन्नप्सरसः सुराश्च ॥

meaning.en: The throngs of Siddhas, gandharvas and pishachas, the serpents, Suparnas, the fathers, birds, the hosts of rakshasas and of spirits, apsarases and gods honored Drona's son.
